meta.goal: Turn the 324 remaining 501 stubs in hermit-api into real handlers.
meta.key_finding: hermit-traits already exposes rich manager traits and hermit-core has concrete impls (Hermit* structs) for essentially every non-deferred subsystem. The dominant work is at the hermit-api layer: (a) widen AppState/Inner to hold the extra Arc<dyn ...> managers, (b) write axum handlers that translate query params -> InternalItemsQuery / DTO options and project via DtoService, (c) register over the 501 stub. Very few genuinely-new hermit-traits methods are required; almost no new hermit-core logic is required outside the by-name browse projection and a couple of write paths.

batches.name: By-name browse foundation (Genres/MusicGenres/Studios/Persons/Years/Artists)
batches.rationale: Most-reused projection: every by-name controller GETs a filtered item list and one item-by-name, reusing InternalItemsQuery + DtoService already proven in Items. Builds the shared 'name-item' handler helper the Image variants (Batch 9) and Filters (Batch 3) lean on. Zero deferred deps.
traits_new: (none) — Years is derived from an InternalItemsQuery group-by that get_query_filters_legacy already surfaces; a thin LibraryManager::get_years may be added if not derivable
batches.notes: The per-name Image sub-routes (…/Images/{imageType}[/{imageIndex}]) are Batch 9. This batch delivers only the JSON browse + single-name GETs.

batches.name: Items query completion + writes/delete + ancestors/counts
batches.rationale: The widest, most-depended-on surface. Fills out the full GetItems query translation (translate_query.rs already exists in core), item writes (POST /Items/{itemId}, ContentType), delete, Counts, Ancestors, Root, Latest. Everything downstream (Suggestions/Search/Filters/UserLibrary) reuses this translation.
traits_new: LibraryManager::get_ancestors (may add) — otherwise walk parent ids via ItemRepository
batches.notes: translate_query.rs in hermit-core (32k) already maps the wide Jellyfin query; this batch mostly wires its parameters through the handler. MetadataEditor uses ProviderManager::get_metadata_options.

batches.name: Filters + Suggestions + Instant-mix + Similar/Recommendations
batches.rationale: Discovery reads built directly on the Batch 2 query + by-name lists. SimilarItemsManager, MusicManager, SearchManager (hints) impls all exist in core.
batches.notes: SearchManager and MusicManager and SimilarItemsManager must be added to AppState (Batch does the wiring).

batches.name: UserLibrary + UserItems + play-state flags
batches.rationale: Per-user reads/writes over items: get item (single, already real), favorites, ratings, played flags, resume, local trailers, special features, theme media, intros. All hang off UserDataManager (impl exists) + LibraryManager.
traits_new: (none) — theme/special/local-trailer lists are InternalItemsQuery filters on extra-type; CriticReviews returns empty QueryResult like Jellyfin

batches.name: Playstate + Sessions playback reporting
batches.rationale: Client playback lifecycle. SessionManager impl (47k) already has on_playback_start/progress/stopped, capabilities, commands. PlayingItems + Sessions/Playing* all forward to it.

batches.name: Users admin + Startup + QuickConnect + Auth providers
batches.rationale: Account CRUD, policy/config, first-run flow, QuickConnect. UserManager + QuickConnect + AuthenticationManager impls exist; only AuthenticateByName/Me are done today.

batches.name: Playlists + Collections
batches.rationale: Playlist/collection CRUD + membership + share users. PlaylistManager + CollectionManager impls (HermitPlaylistManager/HermitCollectionManager) exist with the full method set.

batches.name: TV shows + Next-up + Seasons/Episodes
batches.rationale: Series navigation. TvSeriesManager + NextUpService impls exist (next_up_service.rs 23k, tv_series_manager.rs 28k).

batches.name: Image variants (item/by-name/user/remote)
batches.rationale: Widens the already-real item-image handler to the full matrix: index/format/dimension variants, by-name entity images (built on Batch 1), user image, remote image search/download. ImageProcessor + ProviderManager remote-image methods exist.
traits_new: ImageProcessor is NOT yet in AppState and hermit-core has no concrete ImageProcessor/ImageEncoder impl — NEW core work: a skia/image-rs-backed HermitImageProcessor (or a passthrough that serves the original file + 501 on resize). Recommend a minimal file-serving impl first, resize later.
batches.notes: This is the one read-path batch with real NEW core logic (image decode/resize/blurhash). Original-file serving (no transform) can ship first to unblock clients; parametrized resize follows.

batches.name: Videos + Audio streaming completion + Universal + MediaInfo
batches.rationale: Extends the real /Videos/{itemId}/stream to the audio static-stream siblings, alternate sources, additional parts, attachments, and PlaybackInfo/LiveStreams open/close. Direct-play/static remux uses MediaSourceManager (impl exists). HLS/transcode segment routes are their own deferred concern (see notes).
batches.notes: The transcoding/HLS segment routes (Audio/Videos …/master.m3u8, main.m3u8, hls*/segment, DynamicHls, HlsSegment) require an ffmpeg transcode pipeline (media_encoding trait exists but no runner). Those specific ~24 HLS routes are carved into DEFERRED (see stays_501) — this batch delivers only static/direct-play + playback-info + merge/download/attachments.

batches.name: Subtitles + Lyrics + MediaSegments + Trickplay
batches.rationale: Sidecar media assets. SubtitleManager, LyricManager (stub trait), MediaSegmentManager, TrickplayManager impls all exist in core.
batches.notes: Subtitle stream-conversion routes (Stream.{format}) that transcode a sub track may return the stored sidecar directly; on-the-fly conversion deferred if not already in SubtitleManager.

batches.name: Devices + ApiKeys + Sessions device linkage + ClientLog
batches.rationale: Device registry + API-key admin + client log intake. DeviceManager impl (21k), SessionManager token revoke, ClientEventLogger impl exist.
traits_existing: SessionManager::revoke_user_tokens (api-key issue/list via SessionManager or a keys repo)
traits_new: ApiKey issue/list/revoke — CONFIRM whether SessionManager or a dedicated auth-keys repo backs /Auth/Keys; may add ApiKeyManager methods (list/create/delete) if not present
batches.notes: One open question: /Auth/Keys backing store. Everything else is direct manager forwards.

batches.name: System admin + Configuration + Branding + Localization + DisplayPreferences
batches.rationale: Server config read/write, branding, localization catalogs, logs, activity log, ping/restart/shutdown (mostly wired), display prefs. Managers all exist (ServerConfigurationManager, LocalizationManager, DisplayPreferencesManager).
traits_new: Localization catalog getters may need a thin trait if LocalizationManager isn't yet an AppState-visible trait (it's a concrete struct in core)
Environment directory browse -> filesystem read (small NEW core helper) or reuse ServerApplicationPaths
batches.needs_new_core: partial — Environment directory browsing + config-page listing are small new helpers; the rest is manager forwards. web/ConfigurationPages returns [] (no plugins).

batches.name: Library structure + folders + refresh + merge-versions + item-lookup + external-ids
batches.rationale: Library admin: virtual folders CRUD, media folders, physical paths, refresh, merge/split versions, remote metadata search + apply, external id infos. LibraryManager + ProviderManager methods exist.
traits_new: VirtualFolder CRUD (add/remove library, add/remove path, rename) — CONFIRM present on LibraryManager; likely NEW methods (add_virtual_folder/remove_virtual_folder/add_media_path/...)
MergeVersions -> LinkedChildrenService or NEW LibraryManager merge/split methods
batches.notes: Heaviest new-core batch after images: virtual-folder mutation + version merge/split are structural library ops. Sequenced late because it is admin-only and least reused.

batches.name: Channels + ScheduledTasks
batches.rationale: Channel browse (stub-trait ChannelManager impl exists) and scheduled-task admin (scheduled_tasks.rs 15k in core). Low reuse, self-contained.
traits_new: ScheduledTask trait surface for AppState (list/get/start/cancel/update-triggers) if not already trait-fronted

stays_501: LiveTvController (40 routes) — LiveTv is a DEFERRED subsystem; hermit-core live_tv_manager is a minimal stub (info/programs/reset only). All /LiveTv/* stay 501.
SyncPlayController (22 routes) — SyncPlay DEFERRED; sync_play_manager is a minimal stub (new/join/leave/list). All /SyncPlay/* stay 501.

PluginsController + PackageController + RepositoriesController (24 routes: /Plugins/*, /Packages/*, /Repositories) — plugin install/enable/disable + package repos are DEFERRED (plugin_manager is a minimal stub). All stay 501.
BackupController (4 routes: /Backup, /Backup/Create, /Backup/Manifest, /Backup/Restore) — backup/restore subsystem DEFERRED; no core impl.

HLS/transcoding stream routes (~24: Audio/Videos …/master.m3u8, main.m3u8, live.m3u8, hls/{segment}, hls1/{...}, Audio hls stream.aac/.mp3, LiveTv stream files) — require an ffmpeg transcode/segmenter pipeline (media_encoding trait has no runner). Static/direct-play is delivered in Batch 10; on-the-fly HLS stays 501.

Third-party PLUGIN routes not part of core Jellyfin (all stay 501): Intros/* + Episode/{id}/IntroSkipperSegments + IntroSkipper/* (IntroSkipper plugin ~11), SkipButtonCss/* (2), FileTransformation/RegisterTransformation (1), Jellyfin.Plugin.OpenSubtitles/ValidateLoginInfo (1), Tmdb/ClientConfiguration (1), FallbackFont/Fonts[/{name}] (2 — cosmetic, optional later).
DashboardController config-page listing beyond web/ConfigurationPages=[] — plugin-driven, stays 501 where plugin-backed.
targeting_note: Per-batch routes_to_implement sum to 338 (33+16+20+20+27+25+14+5+34+20+24+10+40+40+10). These counts are generous — they include method variants (GET/HEAD/POST/DELETE) and a handful of routes whose HLS-transcode sibling actually stays 501 (Batch 10 static-only, Batch 11 sidecar-only), so the count of route SLOTS a batch touches slightly exceeds the count that flips 501->real. Deferred (stays_501) buckets cover ~120-130 of the 324: LiveTv 40, SyncPlay 22, Plugins/Packages/Repositories 24, Backup 4, HLS/transcode-stream ~24, third-party plugin ~18 (overlap accounts for the range). Net outcome after all 15 batches: roughly 190-200 previously-501 routes become real (13 already-real + these), i.e. ~55-60% of the 337-path contract, with the balance being the deliberately-deferred subsystems.
